metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, measures motion and pacing, and hands it all to Claude.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video, screen recording, or audio file (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or Whisper, measures animation timing and easing with --motion, and characterizes editing style and pacing.
